items.title: Permanence properties of coverings in SR(C)
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove coverings in SR(C) are closed under composition, base change, and products: (1) is immediate from the axioms of a site since covering morphisms are representable and site coverings compose; (2) follows from the explicit construction of fibre products in SR(C) in the proof of lemma-coprod-prod-SR together with representability of the covering morphisms; (3) factors A x K -> B x L as A x K -> B x K -> B x L, a composition of base changes of the coverings A -> B and K -> L; the SR(C,X) statements follow because SR(C,X) = SR(C/X).
